centersRotation.note: Two separate things are settled here and they do NOT rest on the same amount of evidence — do not cite them as equally confirmed. THE SCHOOL-WIDE PHASE (Aug 24, 2026, first day of school = Day 1) is confirmed by two independent sources that agree: (1) Myles reported having Music on Thu Sep 3, 2026 — the 9th school day; 9 mod 6 = 3, and Day 3 in the sequence below is Music; (2) Mrs. Pitts's teacher-maintained Daily Planner shows Ophelia has PE2 on Tue Sep 8, 2026 — the 10th school day, Sep 4 and Sep 7 being closures; 10 mod 6 = 4, and Day 4 in her sequence is PE2. Both school-day counts were re-derived from isSchoolDay() in digest/schoolRotation.js rather than counted by hand. THIS SEQUENCE — which subject Myles has on each day number — rests on ONE source: observation (1), a verbal report from a child. Observation (2) constrains the phase only and says nothing about his subject map, and the phase it confirms was already established before his sequence was. Given the Open House packet's cyclic order (PE2 / Media / Music / PE1 / Art / Computer — the same school-wide cycle Ophelia sits in, entered three positions ahead; hers begins PE1, see her block) that single report determines the mapping uniquely and the derivation is sound, but no second observation on any other date has been taken. Treat a future contradiction as evidence against this sequence rather than as an anomaly. RETIRED ALTERNATIVE, kept here so it is not re-proposed: an Open House packet-derived reading took the packet's Week 1 table day-by-day, treated its two leading whole-grade Music days as off-rotation, started the cycle on Aug 26, and put Sep 3 on PE1 rather than Music — exactly one cycle position off the confirmed phase. The Sep 8 planner observation is what decided against it. The day positions in `sequence` below encode the confirmed phase. centersGroup is 6, the school-assigned group number confirmed by Wade. The `sequence` below is duplicated as MYLES_CENTERS in digest/schoolRotation.js and the two files can drift; that module is authoritative for anything that renders, because this file is not packaged for the artifact Lambda and resolves to null there — change both together.
